about.title: Palmdale Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Fourteen people died in traffic on Palmdale's streets in 2025, according to public collision records for the city. Behind each of those counts is a household that now has to figure out what comes next. Reported crashes here concentrate along corridors like Palmdale Boulevard, Rancho Vista Boulevard, Avenue S, and Sierra Highway, and they cluster on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m., when commuters are heading home. A wrongful death claim is a civil action, kept separate from any criminal case the Los Angeles County District Attorney may pursue. It lets a spouse, domestic partner, or children seek compensation for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive does not practice law. We are a free service that connects Palmdale families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. You decide when you are ready to talk.

whyChoose.title: What Palmdale Families Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Only certain family members can file
items.desc: California gives the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with certain dependents and heirs eligible in other circumstances. An attorney can confirm who in your family has standing.

items.title: The clock runs from the date of death
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the death, but that window shrinks considerably when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Getting an attorney involved early protects your options.

items.title: The claim is separate from any criminal case
items.desc: Whether or not charges are filed in Los Angeles County, your family can pursue a civil claim for funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of companionship and guidance. One does not depend on the other.

items.question: My husband was killed in a crash on Palmdale Boulevard. Do we have to wait for the police or DA to finish before doing anything?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil matter and moves on its own track, independent of any investigation or criminal case. Evidence from the scene and witness memories are strongest early, so many families choose to speak with an attorney while the official process is still underway. LawProactive can make that connection at no charge.

items.question: What can our family actually recover in a California wrongful death case?
items.answer: Recoverable losses generally include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have contributed over their lifetime, and the loss of their love, companionship, care, and guidance. The exact figure depends on the facts of your case and cannot be predicted in advance. An attorney will walk through what applies to your situation.

items.question: Does it cost anything to use LawProactive or to hire the attorney?
items.answer: Using LawProactive is free. The independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You are never obligated to move forward after the initial conversation.
